name: Alice
source:
Alice yearns for a life past forced betrothals that leave her a trophy to be shown. Her life takes a turn for the unexpected after she follows a strange pale girl with rabbit ears into a hole. She awakens in a new world with cute girls, anthropomorphic animals, and... hot woman?!

[From [url=https://sashaines127.itch.io/alice-short-yuri-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
爱丽丝渴望摆脱被迫订婚、沦为炫耀品的人生。跟随一位长着兔耳、面色苍白的奇怪少女进入洞穴后，她的生活发生了意想不到的转折。她在一个全新的世界醒来，那里有可爱的女孩、拟人化的动物，还有…性感的女人？！

[摘自[url=https://sashaines127.itch.io/alice-short-yuri-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
